Date picker ​

Example data, control text, messages and source comments may be in Chinese. Viewer controls and API headings use English. Untranslated API descriptions are marked.

When to use it ​

AsamDatePicker edits dates and date-time values through an input and a calendar. Use format for what the user sees and valueFormat for how the value is written to the model. Omit valueFormat to use Date values when a date is selected.

Default model format ​

Example: native-values

Show source
Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section class="native-values-example">
		<p class="example-paragraph">
			使用原生模型和默认值；日期/时间未传 valueFormat，选择后保持 Date。
		</p>
		<AsamDatePicker v-model="value" clearable @update:model-value="updates++" />
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="value = undefined">
			显式 undefined
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="value = null">显式 null</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="value = ''">
			显式空字符串
		</AsamButton>
		<output>{{ summary }}；更新次数 {{ updates }}</output>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerNativeValuesExample' });
const value = ref<AsamDateValue>();
const updates = ref(0);
const summary = computed(() =>
	value.value === undefined
		? 'undefined'
		: value.value instanceof Date
			? 'Date ' + value.value.toISOString()
			: JSON.stringify(value.value)
);
</script>

<style scoped>
.native-values-example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="range"
			v-bind="{ type: 'daterange', 'value-format': 'YYYY-MM-DD' }"
			:disabled-date="disabledDate"
		/>
		<output>范围：{{ range }}</output>
	</div>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerRangeExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const range = ref<AsamDateValue>(null);
function disabledDate(value: Date) {
	return value.getFullYear() < 2025;
}
</script>

Set type="daterange" to capture the two ends of a range. Use disabledDate to rule out individual dates. calendar-change reports progress in selecting the range. Read update:modelValue for the committed range. Try the range and its constraints.

Month, year and date-time ranges ​

Example: range-modes

<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="months"
			v-bind="{
				type: 'monthrange',
				'value-format': 'YYYY-MM',
				'start-placeholder': '开始月份',
				'end-placeholder': '结束月份'
			}"
		/>
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="years"
			v-bind="{
				type: 'yearrange',
				'value-format': 'YYYY',
				'start-placeholder': '开始年份',
				'end-placeholder': '结束年份'
			}"
		/>
		<AsamDatePicker

Quarter selection ​

Example: quarter-contract

Example source ZIPComplete project ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section class="demo-layout-1">
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="quarter"
			type="quarter"
			format="YYYY [年第] Q [季度]"
			value-format="YYYY-[Q]Q"
			:disabled-date="disabledDate"
			:default-value="new Date(2026, 0, 1)"
			:teleported="false"
			@change="events.push('change: ' + $event)"
		/>
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="quarters"
			type="quarters"
			value-format="YYYY-[Q]Q"
			:show-footer="true"
			:show-confirm="true"
		/>
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="range"
			type="quarterrange"
			value-format="YYYY-[Q]Q"
			:single-panel="singlePanel"
			:unlink-panels="true"
			:disabled-date="disabledDate"
			:default-value="[new Date(2026, 0, 1), new Date(2027, 0, 1)]"
		/>
		<AsamButton
			native-type="submit"
			type="default"
			@click="limitYear = limitYear === 2026 ? 2027 : 2026"
		>
			切换禁用年份 {{ limitYear }}
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" @click="singlePanel = !singlePanel">
			单面板 {{ singlePanel }}
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton
			native-type="submit"
			type="default"
			@click="
				quarter = '2026-Q2';
				quarters = ['2026-Q1', '2026-Q3'];
				range = ['2026-Q4', '2027-Q2'];
			"
		>
			回填跨年季度
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton
			native-type="submit"
			type="default"
			@click="
				quarter = null;
				quarters = null;
				range = null;
			"
		>
			重置为空
		</AsamButton>
		<output>{{ { quarter, quarters, range, events } }}</output>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerquartercontractExample' });

import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const quarter = ref<AsamDateValue>(null);
const quarters = ref<AsamDateValue>(null);
const range = ref<AsamDateValue>(null);
const limitYear = ref(2026);
const singlePanel = ref(true);
const events = ref<string[]>([]);
const disabledDate = (date: Date) => date.getFullYear() < limitYear.value;
</script>

			class="mb-4"

		>
			<AsamRadioButton value="large">large</AsamRadioButton>
			<AsamRadioButton value="default">default</AsamRadioButton>
			<AsamRadioButton value="small">small</AsamRadioButton>
		</AsamRadioGroup>

				<span class="demonstration">默认</span>
				<AsamDatePicker
					v-model="value1"
					value-format=""
					type="date"
					placeholder="选择日期"
					:size="size"
				/>
			</div>
			<div class="block">
				<span class="demonstration">带快捷选项的选择器</span>
				<AsamDatePicker
					v-model="value2"
					value-format=""
					type="date"
					placeholder="选择日期"
					:disabled-date="disabledDate"
					:shortcuts="shortcuts"
					:size="size"
				/>
			</div>
		</div>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamRadioGroup, AsamRadioButton, AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerofficialdatepickerenterdateExample' });

import { ref } from 'vue';

const size = ref<'default' | 'large' | 'small'>('default');

const value1 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const value2 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');

const shortcuts = [
	{
		text: 'Today',
		value: new Date()
	},
	{
		text: 'Yesterday',
		value: () => {
			const date = new Date();
			date.setTime(date.getTime() - 3600 * 1000 * 24);
			return date;
		}
	},
	{
		text: '一周前',
		value: () => {
			const date = new Date();
			date.setTime(date.getTime() - 3600 * 1000 * 24 * 7);
			return date;
		}
	}
];

const disabledDate = (time: Date) => {
	return time.getTime() > Date.now();
};
function updatesize(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'large' || value === 'default' || value === 'small') size.value = value;
}
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamRadioGroup, AsamRadioButton, AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerofficialdatepickerdaterangeExample' });

import { ref } from 'vue';

const size = ref<'default' | 'large' | 'small'>('default');

const value1 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const value2 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');

const shortcuts = [
	{
		text: '最近一周',
		value: () => {
			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date();
			start.setTime(start.getTime() - 3600 * 1000 * 24 * 7);
			return [start, end];
		}
	},
	{
		text: '最近一个月',
		value: () => {
			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date();
			start.setTime(start.getTime() - 3600 * 1000 * 24 * 30);
			return [start, end];
		}
	},
	{
		text: 'Last 3 months',
		value: () => {
			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date();
			start.setTime(start.getTime() - 3600 * 1000 * 24 * 90);
			return [start, end];
		}
	}
];
function updatesize(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'large' || value === 'default' || value === 'small') size.value = value;
}
</script>

<template>
	<div class="demo-date-picker demo-layout-1">
		<div class="block">
			<span class="demonstration">默认</span>
			<AsamDatePicker
				v-model="value1"
				value-format=""
				type="quarterrange"
				range-separator="To"
				start-placeholder="Start quarter"
				end-placeholder="End quarter"
			/>
		</div>
		<div class="block">
			<span class="demonstration">带快捷选项</span>
			<AsamDatePicker
				v-model="value2"
				value-format=""
				type="quarterrange"
				unlink-panels
				range-separator="To"
				start-placeholder="Start quarter"
				end-placeholder="End quarter"
				:shortcuts="shortcuts"
			/>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerofficialdatepickerquarterrangeExample' });

import { ref } from 'vue';

const value1 = ref<AsamDateValue>();
const value2 = ref<AsamDateValue>();

const shortcuts = [
	{
		text: '本季度',
		value: () => {
			const now = new Date();
			const quarter = Math.floor(now.getMonth() / 3);
			const start = new Date(now.getFullYear(), quarter * 3, 1);
			return [start, now];
		}
	},
	{
		text: 'Last 4 quarters',
		value: () => {
			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date();
			start.setMonth(start.getMonth() - 12);
			return [start, end];
		}
	},
	{
		text: 'Next 8 quarters',
		value: () => {
			const start = new Date();
			const end = new Date();
			end.setMonth(end.getMonth() + 24);
			return [start, end];
		}
	}
];
</script>

<template>
	<div class="demo-date-picker">
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="value"
			type="date"
			placeholder="选择日期"
			format="YYYY/MM/DD"
			value-format="YYYY-MM-DD"
		>
			<template #default="cell">
				<div class="cell" :class="{ current: cell.isCurrent }">
					<span class="text">{{ cell.text }}</span>
					<span v-if="isHoliday(cell)" class="holiday" />
				</div>
			</template>
		</AsamDatePicker>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="month"
			value-format=""
			type="month"
			placeholder="选择月份"
		>
			<template #default="cell">
				<div class="el-date-table-cell" :class="{ current: cell.isCurrent }">
					<span class="el-date-table-cell__text">{{ (cell.text ?? 0) + 1 }}期</span>
				</div>
			</template>
		</AsamDatePicker>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="year"
			value-format=""
			type="year"
			placeholder="选择年份"
		>
			<template #default="cell">
				<div class="el-date-table-cell" :class="{ current: cell.isCurrent }">
					<span class="el-date-table-cell__text">{{ (cell.text ?? 0) + 1 }}y</span>
				</div>
			</template>
		</AsamDatePicker>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="quarter"
			value-format=""
			type="quarter"
			placeholder="选择季度"
		>
			<template #default="cell">
				<div class="el-date-table-cell" :class="{ current: cell.isCurrent }">
					<span class="el-date-table-cell__text">Q{{ +(cell.text ?? 0) + 1 }}</span>
				</div>
			</template>
		</AsamDatePicker>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDatePickerSlots } from '@asam-ui/ui';
type DateCell = Parameters<NonNullable<AsamDatePickerSlots['default']>>[0];
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerofficialdatepickercustomcontentExample' });

import { ref } from 'vue';

const value = ref<AsamDateValue>('2021-10-29');
const month = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const year = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const quarter = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const holidays = [
	'2021-10-01',
	'2021-10-02',
	'2021-10-03',
	'2021-10-04',
	'2021-10-05',
	'2021-10-06',
	'2021-10-07'
];

const isHoliday = ({ dayjs }: DateCell) => {
	return dayjs ? holidays.includes(dayjs.format('YYYY-MM-DD')) : false;
};
</script>

				:shortcuts="shortcuts"
			/>
		</div>

			<span class="demonstration">带默认时间</span>
			<AsamDatePicker
				v-model="value3"

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerofficialdatetimepickerdateandtimeExample' });

import { ref } from 'vue';

const value1 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const value2 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const value3 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const defaultTime = new Date(2000, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0);

const shortcuts = [
	{
		text: 'Today',
		value: new Date()
	},
	{
		text: 'Yesterday',
		value: () => {
			const date = new Date();
			date.setDate(date.getDate() - 1);
			return date;
		}
	},
	{
		text: '一周前',
		value: () => {
			const date = new Date();
			date.setDate(date.getDate() - 7);
			return date;
		}
	}
];
</script>

<template>
	<div class="demo-datetime-picker demo-layout-1">
		<div class="block">
			<span class="demonstration">默认</span>
			<AsamDatePicker
				v-model="value1"
				value-format=""
				type="datetimerange"
				popper-class="asam-doc-datetime-range-popper"
				range-separator="To"
				start-placeholder="Start date"
				end-placeholder="End date"
			/>
		</div>
		<div class="block">
			<span class="demonstration">带快捷项</span>
			<AsamDatePicker
				v-model="value2"
				value-format=""
				type="datetimerange"
				popper-class="asam-doc-datetime-range-popper"
				:shortcuts="shortcuts"
				range-separator="To"
				start-placeholder="Start date"
				end-placeholder="End date"
			/>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerofficialdatetimepickerdateandtimerangeExample' });

import { ref } from 'vue';

const value1 = ref<AsamDateValue>([new Date(2000, 10, 10, 10, 10), new Date(2000, 10, 11, 10, 10)]);
const value2 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');

const shortcuts = [
	{
		text: '最近一周',
		value: () => {
			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date();
			start.setDate(start.getDate() - 7);
			return [start, end];
		}
	},
	{
		text: '最近一个月',
		value: () => {
			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date();
			start.setMonth(start.getMonth() - 1);
			return [start, end];
		}
	},
	{
		text: 'Last 3 months',
		value: () => {
			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date();
			start.setMonth(start.getMonth() - 3);
			return [start, end];
		}
	}
];
</script>

<template>
	<section class="demo-layout-1">
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="chinese">中文本地化</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="disabled">禁用</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamConfigProvider :locale="chinese ? zhCn : en">
			<AsamDatePicker
				:key="chinese ? 'zh-cn' : 'en'"
				v-model="value"
				v-bind="configuration"
				:disabled="disabled"
				@change="changes++"
			>
				<template #default="cell">
					<!-- Scoped cell data stays typed through the public slot. -->
					<span>{{ cell.text }}</span>
				</template>
				<template #prev-month><CaretLeft /></template>
				<template #next-month><CaretRight /></template>
				<template #prev-year><CaretLeft /></template>
				<template #next-year><CaretRight /></template>
				<template #range-separator>→</template>
			</AsamDatePicker>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
		<output>模型 {{ value }}；提交次数 {{ changes }}</output>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamDatePicker, AsamConfigProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDatePickerProps, AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { zhCn, en } from './locale.js';
import { CaretLeft, CaretRight } from '@asam-ui/icons-vue';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerAdvancedContractExample' });
const chinese = ref(true);
const disabled = ref(false);
const changes = ref(0);
const value = ref<AsamDateValue>(null);
const configuration: AsamDatePickerProps = {
	type: 'datetimerange',
	singlePanel: true,
	unlinkPanels: true,
	automaticDropdown: false,
	valueFormat: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss',
	format: 'YYYY/MM/DD HH:mm',
	teleported: false,
	readonly: false,
	clearable: true,
	editable: true,
	placeholder: '日期时间',
	startPlaceholder: '起点',
	endPlaceholder: '终点',
	rangeSeparator: '到',
	popperClass: 'advanced-date-popup',
	popperStyle: { borderWidth: '2px' },
	popperOptions: { strategy: 'absolute' },
	placement: 'bottom',
	fallbackPlacements: ['top', 'bottom'],
	prefixIcon: CaretLeft,
	clearIcon: CaretRight,
	emptyValues: ['', null, undefined],
	valueOnClear: null,
	defaultValue: new Date(2026, 0, 1, 9, 30),
	defaultTime: new Date(2000, 0, 1, 9, 30),
	dateFormat: 'YYYY/MM/DD',
	timeFormat: 'HH:mm',
	showFooter: true,
	showConfirm: true,
	showWeekNumber: true,
	disabledDate: (date: Date) => date.getFullYear() < 2026,
	shortcuts: [{ text: '固定日期', value: new Date(2026, 0, 1, 9, 30) }],
	cellClassName: (date: Date) => (date.getDate() === 1 ? 'advanced-cell' : ''),
	disabledHours: () => [0, 1],
	disabledMinutes: (hour) => (hour === 9 ? [0] : []),
	disabledSeconds: () => [0]
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.demo-layout-1 {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>
ts
import dayjs from 'dayjs';
import dateLocale from 'dayjs/locale/zh-cn.js';

// Register date locale on the same public Day.js instance used by the components.
// The third argument preserves the application default; the provider selects per component.
dayjs.locale(dateLocale, undefined, true);

/** Application-authored dictionary, supplied through the public provider. */
export const zhCn = {
	name: 'zh-cn',
	el: {
		datepicker: {
			now: '当前时刻',
			today: '当前日期',
			cancel: '取消选择',
			clear: '清除选择',
			confirm: '应用选择',
			dateTablePrompt: '方向键选日期，回车确认',
			monthTablePrompt: '方向键选月份',
			quarterTablePrompt: '方向键选季度',
			yearTablePrompt: '方向键选年份',
			selectedDate: '当前选择',
			selectDate: '选择日期',
			selectTime: '选择时间',

			v-model="value"
			:type="mode"
			:teleported="teleported"

			:shortcuts="withShortcut ? shortcuts : []"

			<template #next-year><span aria-hidden="true">»</span></template>
			<template #range-separator>→</template>
		</AsamDatePicker>
		<output>模型 {{ value }}</output>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDateValue, AsamDatePickerProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerSidebarExample' });
const value = ref<AsamDateValue>(null);
const modes: NonNullable<AsamDatePickerProps['type']>[] = [
	'date',
	'datetime',
	'week',
	'month',
	'year',
	'dates',
	'months',
	'years',
	'quarter',
	'quarters',
	'daterange',
	'datetimerange',
	'monthrange',
	'yearrange',
	'quarterrange'
];
const mode = ref<NonNullable<AsamDatePickerProps['type']>>('daterange');
const singlePanel = ref(false);
watch(mode, () => {
	value.value = null;
});
const teleported = ref(true);
const withShortcut = ref(false);
const shortcuts = [
	{
		text: '固定日期',
		value: () =>
			mode.value.endsWith('range')
				? [new Date(2026, 0, 12), new Date(2026, 0, 14)]
				: ['dates', 'months', 'years', 'quarters'].includes(mode.value)
					? [new Date(2026, 0, 12)]
					: new Date(2026, 0, 12)
	}
];
function reset() {
	value.value = null;
}
</script>

vue
<template>
	<section class="demo-layout-1">
		<div>
			<span>清空配置</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="mode" aria-label="清空配置">
				<AsamOption value="default" :label="'默认'">默认</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="false" :label="'false'">false</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="factory-false" :label="'函数返回 false'">
					函数返回 false
				</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="undefined" :label="'函数返回 undefined'">
					函数返回 undefined
				</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="array" :label="'函数返回空数组端点'">
					函数返回空数组端点
				</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="zero" :label="'0 为空'">0 为空</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="epoch" :label="'0 为有效时间戳'">0 为有效时间戳</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</div>
		<div>
			<span>配置来源</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="scope" aria-label="配置来源">
				<AsamOption value="props" :label="'属性'">属性</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="provider" :label="'配置提供器'">配置提供器</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</div>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="range">原生范围</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamConfigProvider v-bind="provider">
			<AsamDatePicker
				:key="scope + ':' + mode + ':' + range"
				v-model="value"
				v-bind="configuration"
				@update:model-value="updates++"
				@change="changes++"
				@clear="onClear"
			/>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="restore">回填有效值</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="observedCalls = factoryCalls">
			读取工厂调用次数
		</AsamButton>
		<output>{{ summary }}</output>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamDatePicker,
	AsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDateValue, AsamDatePickerProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerEmptyValuesExample' });
const mode = ref('default');
const scope = ref('props');
const range = ref(false);
const value = ref<AsamDateValue>(null);
const updates = ref(0);
const changes = ref(0);
const clears = ref(0);
const observedCalls = ref(0);
// Keep the callback counter non-reactive: reading/incrementing a ref inside a native
// computed factory would itself create a dependency and alter callback behavior.
let factoryCalls = 0;
const summary = computed(
	() =>
		'模型 ' +
		JSON.stringify(value.value) +
		'；update ' +
		updates.value +
		'；change ' +
		changes.value +
		'；clear ' +
		clears.value +
		'；工厂 ' +
		observedCalls.value
);
function clearFactory() {
	factoryCalls++;
	return mode.value === 'factory-false'
		? false
		: mode.value === 'array'
			? [null, null]
			: undefined;
}
type EmptyConfiguration = Pick<AsamDatePickerProps, 'emptyValues' | 'valueOnClear'>;
const emptyConfiguration = computed<EmptyConfiguration>(() => ({
	emptyValues:
		mode.value === 'zero'
			? ['', undefined, null, 0]
			: ['', undefined, null, false, [null, null]],
	valueOnClear: ['factory-false', 'undefined', 'array'].includes(mode.value)
		? clearFactory
		: mode.value === 'false'
			? false
			: mode.value === 'zero'
				? 0
				: null
}));
const provider = computed<EmptyConfiguration>(() =>
	scope.value === 'provider' ? emptyConfiguration.value : {}
);
const configuration = computed<AsamDatePickerProps>(() => ({
	type: range.value ? 'datetimerange' : 'datetime',
	format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss',
	valueFormat: mode.value === 'epoch' || mode.value === 'zero' ? 'x' : 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss',
	...(scope.value === 'props' ? emptyConfiguration.value : {})
}));
function restore() {
	value.value =
		mode.value === 'zero'
			? range.value
				? [86400000, 172800000]
				: 86400000
			: mode.value === 'epoch'
				? range.value
					? [0, 86400000]
					: 0
				: range.value
					? ['2026-01-12 09:30:00', '2026-01-14 17:30:00']
					: '2026-01-12 09:30:00';
}
function onClear() {
	clears.value++;
	observedCalls.value = factoryCalls;
}
watch([mode, scope, range], restore);
restore();
</script>

	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

			<AsamSelect v-model="mode" aria-label="清空配置">
				<AsamOption value="default" :label="'默认'">默认</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="false" :label="'false'">false</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="factory-false" :label="'函数返回 false'">
					函数返回 false
				</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="undefined" :label="'函数返回 undefined'">
					函数返回 undefined
				</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="array" :label="'函数返回空数组端点'">
					函数返回空数组端点
				</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="zero" :label="'0 为空'">0 为空</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="epoch" :label="'0 为有效时间戳'">0 为有效时间戳</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</div>
		<div>
			<span>配置来源</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="scope" aria-label="配置来源">
				<AsamOption value="props" :label="'属性'">属性</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="provider" :label="'配置提供器'">配置提供器</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</div>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="range">原生范围</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamConfigProvider v-bind="provider">
			<AsamDatePicker
				:key="scope + ':' + mode + ':' + range"
				v-model="value"
				v-bind="configuration"
				@update:model-value="updates++"
				@change="changes++"
				@clear="onClear"
			/>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="restore">回填有效值</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="observedCalls = factoryCalls">
			读取工厂调用次数
		</AsamButton>
		<output>{{ summary }}</output>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup>
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamDatePicker,
	AsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerEmptyValuesExample' });
const mode = ref('default');
const scope = ref('props');
const range = ref(false);
const value = ref(null);
const updates = ref(0);
const changes = ref(0);
const clears = ref(0);
const observedCalls = ref(0);
// Keep the callback counter non-reactive: reading/incrementing a ref inside a native
// computed factory would itself create a dependency and alter callback behavior.
let factoryCalls = 0;
const summary = computed(
	() =>
		'模型 ' +
		JSON.stringify(value.value) +
		'；update ' +
		updates.value +
		'；change ' +
		changes.value +
		'；clear ' +
		clears.value +
		'；工厂 ' +
		observedCalls.value
);
function clearFactory() {
	factoryCalls++;
	return mode.value === 'factory-false'
		? false
		: mode.value === 'array'
			? [null, null]
			: undefined;
}
const emptyConfiguration = computed(() => ({
	emptyValues:
		mode.value === 'zero'
			? ['', undefined, null, 0]
			: ['', undefined, null, false, [null, null]],
	valueOnClear: ['factory-false', 'undefined', 'array'].includes(mode.value)
		? clearFactory
		: mode.value === 'false'
			? false
			: mode.value === 'zero'
				? 0
				: null
}));
const provider = computed(() => (scope.value === 'provider' ? emptyConfiguration.value : {}));
const configuration = computed(() => ({
	type: range.value ? 'datetimerange' : 'datetime',
	format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss',
	valueFormat: mode.value === 'epoch' || mode.value === 'zero' ? 'x' : 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss',
	...(scope.value === 'props' ? emptyConfiguration.value : {})
}));
function restore() {
	value.value =
		mode.value === 'zero'
			? range.value
				? [86400000, 172800000]
				: 86400000
			: mode.value === 'epoch'
				? range.value
					? [0, 86400000]
					: 0
				: range.value
					? ['2026-01-12 09:30:00', '2026-01-14 17:30:00']
					: '2026-01-12 09:30:00';
}
function onClear() {
	clears.value++;
	observedCalls.value = factoryCalls;
}
watch([mode, scope, range], restore);
restore();
</script>

<style scoped>
.demo-layout-1 {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

Set valueFormat explicitly when migrating a model that expects strings. Review emptyValues and valueOnClear for the empty-value representation required by the application. Try the empty-value settings.

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamDatePicker,
	AsamTimePicker,
	AsamDateTimePicker,
	AsamDateTimeRangePicker
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamControlSize,
	AsamDatePickerProps,
	AsamDateValue,
	AsamTimeValue,
	DateTimeRangeValue
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamPickerClassValuesExample' });
const sizes: AsamControlSize[] = ['large', 'big', 'default', 'small'];
const size = ref<AsamControlSize>('big');
const enabled = ref(true);
const teleported = ref(true);
const mode = ref('object');
const date = ref<AsamDateValue>('2026-01-12');
const time = ref<AsamTimeValue>('09:30:00');
const legacy = ref<DateTimeRangeValue>(['2026-01-12 09:30:00', '2026-01-14 17:30:00']);
const range = ref<DateTimeRangeValue>(['2026-01-12 09:30:00', '2026-01-14 17:30:00']);
const popperClass = computed<AsamDatePickerProps['popperClass']>(() => {
	const object = { 'asam-example-popup': enabled.value, 'asam-example-hidden': false };
	if (mode.value === 'object') return object;
	if (mode.value === 'array') return ['asam-example-array', [object, false]];
	if (mode.value === 'string') return enabled.value ? 'asam-example-popup' : '';
	if (mode.value === 'false') return false;
	if (mode.value === 'null') return null;
	return undefined;
});
</script>

Use popperClass to style the popup and teleported or appendTo to control where it mounts. Styles for a popup mounted under the document body must be available there. Try popup classes.

Default values ​

The default type is date, and the default display format depends on the type. The initial model is an empty string. Set valueFormat when you need the selected date encoded in a specific format.
